items.title: Turkiye Is Bankasi AS (IST:ISBTR) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Strong NIM Expansion and ...
items.summary: Swap-adjusted net interest income jumped 107% year-on-year and capital adequacy climbed to 17.2%, yet 57% OpEx growth and mounting retail NPLs put the bank's profitability guidance under pressure.
